title: HOW TO #6: Power a House With a Waterfall
caption:
How to power a house with a waterfall 💧⚡

A waterfall behind your house and no electricity. 10 problems, 10 fixes: a wooden wheel, a steel pipe, a generator with a water hose, a battery bank, a leaf mesh, a heated intake, a cable buried 1 meter deep. The house runs on 5 kilowatts, day and night.

Would you live there if the waterfall dried up in summer? Comment POWER below. Tag the friend who pays the biggest electricity bill. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #7!
